name: Small meeting from supplied context
query: Draft only a 15-minute agenda for my internal check-in with Lee. We need to review the cache rollout, decide whether to expand beyond 10%, and assign the monitoring follow-up.
success_criteria: Returns one concise agenda in chat with time allocations totaling at most 15 minutes.
Includes rollout review, the expansion decision, and assigning the follow-up.
Does not create a pre-read, save pages, or perform unnecessary searches.
Does not claim the expansion decision has already been made.
